moworks.notes: Two flat panels, each half the frame wide, meet at the centre over still content and slide apart: left x 0 → −105 % of its width, right 0 → +105 %, 720 ms power2.inOut (easeInOutCubic), symmetric. A 1 px edge line and a 3×24 px grip bar (10 px in from the edge) ride each inner edge. Closing: the same move reversed in 450 ms. (Demo frame 180×120 px, radius 10 px.) Params: duration (0.72 s) · close: thời gian đóng (0.45 s) · edge: vạch mép + tay nắm (bật/tắt) · ease (power2.inOut).
